answer: To validate supply-chain telemetry for cedar timber and willow exports at a port wharf, we construct dynamic opportunity-cost bonds governed by a subgame-perfect punishment matrix. By imposing quadratic collateral scaling on node registration, the expected payoff of identity multiplication remains strictly negative across all adversarial strategies. Consequently, Sybil duplication incurs absolute capital depletion, driving multi-agent consensus to converge upon a unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
